text_en: The word of the Lord came to me, saying:
text_cn: 上主的话传给我说：

text_en: Go and proclaim in the hearing of Jerusalem, Thus says the Lord : I remember the devotion of your youth, your love as a bride, how you followed me in the wilderness, in a land not sown.
text_cn: “你去！向耶路撒冷大声疾呼说：上主这样说：我忆起你年轻时的热情，你订婚时的恋爱；那时你在旷野里，在未耕种的地上追随了我。

text_en: Israel was holy to the Lord , the first fruits of his harvest. All who ate of it were held guilty; disaster came upon them, says the Lord .
text_cn: 以色列成了上主的圣民，成了他收获的初果，凡吞食她的，都要有罪，灾祸必要因此降在他们身上──上主的断语。”

text_en: Hear the word of the Lord , O house of Jacob, and all the families of the house of Israel.
text_cn: 雅各伯家和以色列家的一切家族！你们听上主的话，

text_en: Thus says the Lord : What wrong did your ancestors find in me that they went far from me, and went after worthless things, and became worthless themselves?
text_cn: 上主这样说：你们的祖先在我身上发现了什么不义，竟远离我而去追随“虚无”，自成为虚无呢？

text_en: They did not say, “Where is the Lord who brought us up from the land of Egypt, who led us in the wilderness, in a land of deserts and pits, in a land of drought and deep darkness, in a land that no one passes through, where no one lives? ”
text_cn: 他们也不问一问：那曾引我们由埃及地上来，那经过旷野、荒原和崎岖之地，干旱和黑暗之地，没人游历，无人居住之地，引领我们的上主现在哪里呢？

text_en: I brought you into a plentiful land to eat its fruits and its good things. But when you entered you defiled my land, and made my heritage an abomination.
text_cn: 我引你们进入了肥沃的土地，吃食其中的出产和美物；但你们一进来，就玷污了我的土地，使我的产业成了可憎之物。

text_en: The priests did not say, “Where is the Lord ? ” Those who handle the law did not know me; the rulers transgressed against me; the prophets prophesied by Baal, and went after things that do not profit.
text_cn: 司祭们也不问一问：“上主在哪里？”那些管理法律的，不认识我了；那些为人牧的，叛离了我；先知们也奉巴耳讲预言，追随无能的神祇。

text_en: Therefore once more I accuse you, says the Lord , and I accuse your children’s children.
text_cn: 为此，我要控诉你们──上主的断语，也要控诉你们的子孙。

text_en: Cross to the coasts of Cyprus and look, send to Kedar and examine with care; see if there has ever been such a thing.
text_cn: 好吧！你们往基廷岛屿去观察一下，派人到刻达尔去详细调查，看看有没有与此相类似的事：

text_en: Has a nation changed its gods, even though they are no gods? But my people have changed their glory for something that does not profit.
text_cn: 难道有一个民族更换了自己的神祇？──虽然他们并非真神；但是我的人民竟以自己的光荣，换取了一个“无能的东西”。

text_en: Be appalled, O heavens, at this, be shocked, be utterly desolate, says the Lord ,
text_cn: 诸天！你们对此应惊骇战栗，大为惊异──上主的断语，

text_en: for my people have committed two evils: they have forsaken me, the fountain of living water, and dug out cisterns for themselves, cracked cisterns that can hold no water.
text_cn: 因为我的人民犯了双重的罪恶：他们离弃了我这活水的泉源，却给自己掘了蓄水池，不能蓄水的漏水池。

text_en: Is Israel a slave? Is he a homeborn servant? Why then has he become plunder?
text_cn: 以色列岂是奴隶，或是家生的奴隶？为什么竟成了人的掠夺物？

text_en: The lions have roared against him, they have roared loudly. They have made his land a waste; his cities are in ruins, without inhabitant.
text_cn: 狮子向她咆哮，高声吼叫：它们使她的地域成了荒野，使她的城市化为灰炉，无人居住。

text_en: Moreover, the people of Memphis and Tahpanhes have broken the crown of your head.
text_cn: 连诺夫和塔黑培乃斯的子民，也削去你的脑盖。

text_en: Have you not brought this upon yourself by forsaking the Lord your God, while he led you in the way?
text_cn: 你这不是自作自受吗？因为上主你的天主在路上引导你的时候，你竟离弃了他。

text_en: What then do you gain by going to Egypt, to drink the waters of the Nile? Or what do you gain by going to Assyria, to drink the waters of the Euphrates?
text_cn: 现在你又为什么跑到埃及去喝尼罗河的水，跑到亚述去喝幼发拉的河水？

text_en: Your wickedness will punish you, and your apostasies will convict you. Know and see that it is evil and bitter for you to forsake the Lord your God; the fear of me is not in you, says the Lord God of hosts.
text_cn: 是你的罪恶惩罚你，是你的不忠责斥你，那么你应该明白觉察：离弃上主你的天主，对我没有敬畏，是如何邪恶和痛苦的事──我主万军上主的断语。

text_en: For long ago you broke your yoke and burst your bonds, and you said, “I will not serve! ” On every high hill and under every green tree you sprawled and played the whore.
text_cn: 的确，从古以来，你就折断了你的轭，挣断了你的绳索说：我不愿服从；反在一切高丘上，和一切绿树下，偃（yǎn）卧行淫。

text_en: Yet I planted you as a choice vine, from the purest stock. How then did you turn degenerate and become a wild vine?
text_cn: 我种植你时，原是精选的葡萄，纯粹的真种子；你怎么竟给我变成坏树，成了野葡萄？

text_en: Though you wash yourself with lye and use much soap, the stain of your guilt is still before me, says the Lord God .
text_cn: 现在即使你用盐洗濯（zhuó），多加卤汁，你的罪污仍留在我面前──我主上主的断语──

text_en: How can you say, “I am not defiled, I have not gone after the Baals”? Look at your way in the valley; know what you have done— a restive young camel interlacing her tracks,
text_cn: 你怎能说：我没有玷污我自己，我没有追随过巴耳？观察你在谷中的行动，便知你的行动，无异一只到处游荡，敏捷的母骆驼；

text_en: a wild ass at home in the wilderness, in her heat sniffing the wind! Who can restrain her lust? None who seek her need weary themselves; in her month they will find her.
text_cn: 又像一头习惯在荒野，急欲求配，呼气喘息的野母驴；谁能抑制它的性欲？凡寻找它的，不必费辛苦，在她春情发动的月分，就可找着。

text_en: Keep your feet from going unshod and your throat from thirst. But you said, “It is hopeless, for I have loved strangers, and after them I will go. ”
text_cn: 留心！不要使你的脚赤裸，不要使你的喉咙干渴！但是你却说：不会，不可能！我既爱异邦神祇，我要跟随他们。

text_en: As a thief is shamed when caught, so the house of Israel shall be shamed— they, their kings, their officials, their priests, and their prophets,
text_cn: 就如小偷被人发现时，感到羞愧；以色列家：他们，他们的君王和首领，他们的司祭和先知，都要同样蒙受羞辱。

text_en: who say to a tree, “You are my father, ” and to a stone, “You gave me birth. ” For they have turned their backs to me, and not their faces. But in the time of their trouble they say, “Come and save us! ”
text_cn: 他们对木偶说：你是我的父亲；对石碣（jié）说：是你生了我。的确，他们不但向我转过脸去，而且也以背向着我；但是，在他们遭难的时候，却喊说：起来，拯救我们！

text_en: But where are your gods that you made for yourself? Let them come, if they can save you, in your time of trouble; for you have as many gods as you have towns, O Judah.
text_cn: 你自己制造的神祇在哪里？在你遭难的时候，他们若能救你，就让他们起来！因为犹大！你神祇的数目竟等于你城邑的数目，巴耳的香坛与耶路撒冷的街道一般多。

text_en: Why do you complain against me? You have all rebelled against me, says the Lord .
text_cn: 你们背叛了我，为什么又向我提出抗议──上主的断语──

text_en: In vain I have struck down your children; they accepted no correction. Your own sword devoured your prophets like a ravening lion.
text_cn: 我打击了你们的子孙，竟是徒然，你们没有受到教训；你们的刀剑如同一只凶残的狮子，吞灭了众先知。

text_en: And you, O generation, behold the word of the Lord ! Have I been a wilderness to Israel, or a land of thick darkness? Why then do my people say, “We are free, we will come to you no more”?
text_cn: 你们这一代人，体会上主的话吧！难道我对以色列像一个荒野，或像一个黑暗的地方？为什么我的人民说：我们获得了自由，我们不再来找你？

text_en: Can a girl forget her ornaments, or a bride her attire? Yet my people have forgotten me, days without number.
text_cn: 一个处女岂能忘了自己的珍饰？一位新娘岂能忘了自己的彩带？我的人民却忘了我，时日已久长，无法计算。

text_en: How well you direct your course to seek lovers! So that even to wicked women you have taught your ways.
text_cn: 你怎么会如此想尽好方法去求爱？你也将你的方法教给了邪恶的女人；

text_en: Also on your skirts is found the lifeblood of the innocent poor, though you did not catch them breaking in. Yet in spite of all these things
text_cn: 连在你的衣边上也发现无辜穷人的血渍：并不是在挖掘洞穴时，你捉住他们，而是在橡树边。

text_en: you say, “I am innocent; surely his anger has turned from me. ” Now I am bringing you to judgment for saying, “I have not sinned. ”
text_cn: 但你还说：我是无罪的，他的忿怒已离我远去。看！我要审判你，正因为你说：我没有犯罪。

text_en: How lightly you gad about, changing your ways! You shall be put to shame by Egypt as you were put to shame by Assyria.
text_cn: 你为什么这样轻易改变你的道路？你必要因埃及而蒙羞，犹如曾因亚述而蒙羞一样。

text_en: From there also you will come away with your hands on your head; for the Lord has rejected those in whom you trust, and you will not prosper through them.
text_cn: 你毕竟要从那里抱头出走，因为上主摈弃了你所仗恃的，使你不能靠他们获得成功。
